notes.title: AURELIA 1.0.1 IS HERE! SPANISH HAS ARRIVED!
notes.notes:
[h2]Thanks everyone for supporting and playing Aurelia. The first patch is here! [/h2]

Here are the patch notes:

- Added Spanish (Spain) and Spanish (LATAM)
- Solved some display issues in the Journal that would show hints even if the questline was completed.
- Reworked the display of “Item Lore” in the inventory to allow even the longest descriptions to fit in the box.
- Fixed the achievement "Honoring our Royalty" triggering multiple times.
- Fixed the achievement “Drinking Buddies” triggering multiple times.
- Blackjack achievements should now be unlockable on Steam.
- The game will now check for in-game achievements when entering the Achievements submenu and unlock any achievement your save has that Steam doesn’t.
- Fixed “Shiny Blessing” achievement not unlocking in some instances.
- Improved the font display for Russian.
- Eliminated the "Patch notes button" as it was creating other unintended side effects. Patch notes will be now be hosted on appropriate platform.
- Disabled the “Bug Report” feature, as it was causing unintentional side effects. Pressing the button will still unlock the related achievement.
- Bar minigame will no longer “slowly drain HP”, missing clients will instead lose 15 HP.
- Exorcised Scarlet so she doesn't appear levitating at night in Ivy's room.
- Nerfed Ivy's speed so she can't be on two rooms at once.
- Scarlet “[Firewood]” option will not appear until quest conditions have been met.
- Changed Karos Dialogue so he doesn't ask for wood anymore.
- Fixed instances where the Audio could load from an older save to a value over 100%
- Fixed an issue where the “Catch bar” in the fishing minigame could go out of bounds.

If you need bug support, have feedback, or want to hang with others of culture,[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/aureliagame/] stop by r/aureliagame[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/twzMbu8]visit the official Discord.[/url]

Ciao for now!

notes.title: BANNED in South Korea!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804903/ab976569e06b0d3604fc48016f74ca98a04718c8.png[/img]

[b]Hi everyone! Thanks for playing and supporting Aurelia.[/b]

Unfortunately, the fun-hating government officials over in South Korea have brought the hammer down on this humble titty game for its "excessive lewdness". [b]It's now region-locked in Korea and hidden from the Steam store for Korean users.[/b]

[b]Sadly, we have no power over this. We're sorry, to both our current and prospective Korean players.[/b] Your support has been fucking awesome! Rest assured that the game will still have Korean language support as always.

Til next time!

notes.title: THE TIME IS NIGH! AURELIA RELEASES TOMORROW!
notes.notes:
Hello again! Thanks for all the support, patience, and overall coolness many of you have shown while we handled the various delays—both from bug-fixing and localization to the Steam hiccups. It's been a rough time for us all, especially Mirthal... 

[h3]But we're happy to say that the game is coming out tomorrow! [b]100%. For real. Promise. 🙏[/b][/h3]

Today's the day to stock up on lube, lotion, tissues, whatever you fancy—maybe treat yourself to a new sock, even. See you degens tomorrow!

notes.title: Release delayed a little bit longer, hang in there everyone!
notes.notes:
Steam's informed us that they are running an additional "check" on the game before we can release, which they've stated can take on average 1-3 business days (not including weekends). 

This means unfortunately [b]Aurelia will be forced to release later, probably sometime next week,[/b] something we're not very happy about but it is what it is.

Very sorry for the inconvenience, thanks for being patient and supporting the game. It'll be dropping the moment Steam gives the okay!

In the meantime, have a catgirl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38804903/c5682cf3f9ed28764ef99076a8c0556ffe6c230a.png[/img]
